responsibility: This is the central Modula-2 runtime system implementation for the mc-boot library set. It coordinates module construction and destruction through M2Dependent, manages installed initial and termination procedure chains, controls HALT/Terminate/ExitOnHalt behavior and user-facing fatal diagnostics, provides runtime string-length support, and exports the family of language-runtime exception raisers that map specific semantic failures to RTExceptions/M2EXCEPTION codes, making it the main orchestration layer for startup, shutdown, termination, and language-level runtime faults.
same_name_distinction: Contains the runtime system implementation behind GM2RTS.h: it manages procedure chains, startup/shutdown orchestration through M2Dependent, HALT/terminate behavior, diagnostics, LENGTH support, and the concrete exception-raising entry points.
